revenueModel.text: Clients pay fees for assistance obtaining, renewing and complying with business licenses, plus corporate secretarial, regulatory consultancy and outsourcing work.
revenueModel.evidence: Our corporate services income is mainly generated from fees we receive assisting our clients obtain, renew and comply with a range of business licenses (primarily including brokerage licenses and other financial licenses) in a variety of jurisdictions (primarily in London, Cyprus and Belize).
